title: Study to evaluate the comparative efficacy of LacTEST for the diagnosis of hypolactasia in children presenting symptoms of lactose intolerance.
official: Post-authorization phase IV low-intervention study to evaluate the efficacy under real-world conditions of the use of LacTEST 0.45 g for the diagnosis of hypolactasia in children aged 5 to 11 years presenting symptoms of lactose intolerance.
summary: Main objective: The primary objective is the confirmation of the cut-off point proposed in the Phase I study, 19.18 mg of xylose in 5 hours of urine accumulation, to explore whether this cut-off point can classify pediatric patients as hypolactasic or normolactasic when compared with the definitive diagnosis according to the routine clinical practice.

interventions.name: LacTEST 0,45 g polvo para solución oral.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Either male of female children between 5 or 11 years of age.
2. Participant’s parent(s)/legal guardian(s) are willing and able to comply with all scheduled visits, treatment plan, laboratory tests, lifestyle considerations, and other study procedures.
3. Participants with symptoms of lactose intolerance
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participant’s parent(s)/legal guardian(s) are not willing or able to comply with either: all scheduled visits, treatment plan, laboratory tests, lifestyle considerations, or other study procedures.
2. Participant has a known history of substance abuse.
3. Participant has taken either acetylsalicylic acid or indomethacin in the 48 hours prior to study enrollment.
4. Participant has been previously diagnosed as hypolactasic.
5. Any condition or situation precluding or interfering with the compliance with the protocol.
6. Participant has a known or suspected allergy or history of anaphylaxis or other serious adverse reactions to Gaxilose (LacTEST 0,45g).
7. Participant has a known or suspected allergy or history of anaphylaxis or other serious adverse reactions to any of the ingredients of the on-site meals.
8. Participant has a known medical history of decreased renal function of any cause
9. Participant has a known medical history of either clinical or systemic manifestation of portal hypertension (i.e., ascites, cirrhosis…).
10. Participant has a known medical history of total gastrectomy and/or vagotomy.
11. Participant has a known medical history of myxoedema.
12. Participant has a known medical history of pentosuria and/or galactosaemia.
13. Participant is currently enrolled or has enrolled in a clinical trial three months prior to inclusion in the current study.
